messages:
micah: FYI scheduling a multi-region maintenance for next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. Need everyone aware — this touches routing and kv-cache compaction.

alisha: tagging the rollout plan in this thread. primary goal = safe drain + warmup. low-risk window but we’ll run a short load ramp at the end to validate.

karim: +1. can we make the SLO adjustment temporary for the window? propose p99 latency SLO relaxed from 120ms -> 220ms between 02:00-04:00 UTC, and we auto-revert.

micah: agreed. update: SLO change will be a scheduled policy change via infra controlplane, auto-revert at 04:05. Put an alert suppression for noise.

sre-oncall: Please post the exact controlplane command we’ll run and assign rollback owners. I’ll be oncall that night.

micah: Command we’ll run (dry-run tested):
```
./infractl set-slo --route "api.redwood.com" --p99-ms 220 --window 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z/2026-05-12T04:05:00Z --note "maintenance relax"
```
Rollback is automatic at 04:05. human rollback: `./infractl set-slo --route api.redwood.com --p99-ms 120`.

ops-bot: scheduled: maintenance-start at 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z for routes: api.redwood.com, inference.usw1.redwood, inference.use1.redwood. ID: mnt-20260512-02.

karim: For the load ramp at the end — plan to run a 10m progressive ramp to 200rps to validate kv-cache warmup and fallback routing. Will simulate via `loadtest/kvcache_warmup.py`.

marie: Noting potential customer impact: Dedicated customers on reserved capacity should be isolated, but we’ll notify customers with >10k monthly tokens. I can schedule the email notice.

timothy: One more: can we enable model-fallback to smaller-quantized variant during the 02:00-03:00 window only? That will reduce tail latency risk. Anyone object?

alisha: No objections. Need a canary first: run fallback in one region (usw1) for 15m at 02:10 before global switch. If p99 stays under 250ms, proceed.

micah: Canary accepted. Sequence summary: 02:00 begin drains + SLO relax, 02:10 canary fallback in usw1 (15m), 02:30 global fallback + compaction, 03:50 begin load ramp (10m to 200rps), 04:05 revert SLO + end maintenance.

sre-oncall: I'll own the canary monitoring and pause the rollout if error rate >0.5% or p99 > 300ms. My contact: @sre-oncall on pager.

ops-bot: checklist added to ticket mnt-20260512-02: preflight run, canary checklist, rollback instructions, postmortem template.

karim: Quick config snippet for canary toggle:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  enabled: true
  regions: [usw1]
  target_model: redwood-quantized-v2
  duration: 15m
```

marie: I scheduled the customer notice for 36h before, heading to be sent tomorrow.

timothy: Heads up for console dashboards: please instrument a per-route heatmap for 00:00-06:00 UTC next Tue so post-checks are easy.

micah: Thanks all. Final ask: if you have post-change observations, drop short notes here. We’ll hold a 30m postmortem the next day at 10:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
